# What's new?
Release v0.15.0 consolidates several feature additions and improvements to the Sage ADR platform, expanding agent runtime support and enhancing prompt injection detection capabilities.

## New Connectors
- Pi connector (@gendigital/sage-pi): Guards pi tool_call events for bash, powershell, write, edit, read, grep, find, ls, web_search, and url_context. Includes status line integration, MCP server registration, and skill scanning at session start.
- Oh My Pi connector (@gendigital/sage-omp): In-process hook covering bash, eval, debug, write, read, edit (all modes), and ast_edit. Ships as CommonJS bundle with 10-minute approval persistence.
- Hook host package (@gendigital/sage-hook-host): Shared handler infrastructure for pi/OMP connectors, exporting registerHookHandlers with verdict-to-hook-result mapping.

## Detection Enhancements
- Obfuscated prompt injection detection: Scans deobfuscated variants including leetspeak, letter-spaced text, zero-width/fullwidth characters, and base64/hex encoding (up to two levels deep). Only transforms content when transformation reveals injection-relevant keywords.
- Custom threat rules: Load user-defined rules from ~/.sage/threats/*.yaml alongside bundled rules. Bundled IDs take precedence; cap at 10,000 combined rules.
- Submit-only rules: New flags: ["submit_only"] option for telemetry-only rules that never affect verdicts. Rate-limited to once per 24 hours per rule per installation.
- New rule CLT-PI-094: Detects system prompt override attempts ("disregard your system prompt").

## Platform Updates
- OpenCode v2 support: Single package definition supporting both v1 (server) and v2 (setup). V2 hooks tool.execute.before, handles new tool names (shell, patch, subagent), and uses the built-in question form for approvals.
- Online classifier naming: Unique identifiers for classifier hits in audit/telemetry: Text:OnlineClassifier [Misc]|<model version>-<text hash>|sgpi.

## UX Improvements
- False positive hint: Session-start alerts and runtime block messages now include guidance on reporting false positives via the sage_report_false_positive MCP tool.

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed false positive in CLT-CRED-001 credential detection.

# What's new?
Sage 0.14.0 lets you report false-positive Skill Analyzer findings and fixes a false "version not found" warning for pnpm catalog: dependencies.

## Highlights
- You can now report risky Skill Analyzer findings as false positives, the same way you already report false positives for commands, files, and URLs. Sage also makes sure you're always shown the latest verdict for a skill — so if a finding gets re-checked and cleared, the old "risky" result won't still be sitting there asking you to report it.

## Detection quality and fixes
- Sage no longer wrongly flags pnpm catalog:-managed dependencies as having an unrecognized/missing version.

This small release fixes only OpenClaw issue that was blocking us to reach ClawHub, details below.

## Fixes
- Surface scan findings and one-time notices via `before_prompt_build` instead of the legacy `before_agent_start` hook, which OpenClaw removed in 2026.9.x. Registering the removed hook made ClawHub's Plugin Inspector reject the package (`unknown-hook-name`), so v0.13.0 never reached ClawHub.

# What's new?
Sage 0.13.0 makes detections easier to understand, reduces command-rule false positives, and adds more control over Claude Code integration.

## Highlights
- Show triggering rule IDs in detection notifications, audit entries, deny messages, and false-positive guidance across supported agents.
- Provide tailored remediation for blocks caused by user-defined exception rules.
- Add stable canonical names and version metadata for heuristic, prompt-injection, package, and AMSI detections.
- Add manage_status_line to disable Claude Code status-line management and its startup hint.

## Detection quality and fixes
- Tighten command, token, and RC-file matching to reduce false positives.
- Improve command-position detection, including quoted text and Windows .exe commands.
- Standardize shell detection across rules, including ash, busybox, powershell, and pwsh.
- Include evidence snippets for prompt-injection detections in audit and telemetry events.

# What's new ?
Sage 0.12.0 expands skill security analysis, improves prompt-injection detection, and strengthens compatibility across supported agents.

## Highlights
- Scan installed skills and surface security verdicts in the status line.
- Cache skill verdicts and asynchronously upload unknown skills for analysis.
- Enable skill analysis uploads for OpenCode and OpenClaw.
- Adopt the retrained prompt-injection classifier (`pi-model` 1.0.3) through the new `v2` model schema.
- Send non-blocking prompt-injection near misses to the Community IQ heuristics endpoint when Community IQ is enabled.

## Compatibility and security fixes
- Support the PascalCase tool names and updated input fields introduced by GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.63.
- Promote unsupported or unenforced `ask` verdicts to `deny` in Cursor `preToolUse` and `beforeReadFile` hooks.
- Prevent Claude Code status-line setup from overwriting settings when the existing settings file cannot be read.
- Publish versioned default configuration metadata at `~/.sage/config.defaults.json` for external tooling.
